changelog: Say "select all" — or "সব সিলেক্ট করো" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and all the text is selected; say "copy" / "কপি করো" and the message is copied (it selects everything first when nothing is selected, then puts the cursor back at the end so you can keep dictating); say "paste" / "পেস্ট করো" and the clipboard is pasted at the cursor. Google's voice typing documents all three, but this keyboard only had them behind long-press keys until now.
